listings.description: Ten years of Hawas, marked with a single limited run. Hawas Boa was created in collaboration with fragrance creator Fragrance Flan and composed by perfumer Théo Belmas, taking the Hawas signature tropical and green. It opens juicy and bright on Madagascar pomelo, prickly pear and crisp green apple, with orange blossom keeping the top lifted rather than sweet. Tonka bean brings a creamy warmth, driftwood and olibanum a dry resinous edge, and the base lands on sandalwood, ambronova, vetiver and vanilla — creamy, woody, with a smooth gourmand finish. Loud on the opening, refined on the dry down. The bottle carries a metallic serpent sculpted in raised 3D across emerald crackle glass, with a ribbed collar cap and silver Arabic script. Rasasi produced 150,000 bottles worldwide for the anniversary, with no further production planned.

The 2015 launch that started the Hawas legacy and became one of Rasasi's most celebrated best-sellers. An aromatic aquatic Eau de Parfum built to embody masculine strength and vigour — citrus, watery, spicy and woody notes for the man whose presence is a quiet language of distinguished taste.

The cooler, brighter sibling to the original Hawas. Icy clarity of a fresh winter morning meeting modern masculine refinement — premium Italian citrus, crisp apple and the licorice-tinged sophistication of star anise.

The FBF Edition of Hawas Sapphire — a vibrant, electric Eau de Parfum for him, inspired by the energy of the ocean caught beneath a flash of lightning. Crisp citrus and sun-warmed spice open with a refreshing rush, while orange blossom and sandalwood add depth and a warm musk-and-ambergris base keeps it engaging. Bright, powerful and confidently masculine — built for spring and summer, daytime wear and travel, with enough spice to carry into the evening. Often searched as Hawas Saphire — this is the genuine Rasasi Hawas Sapphire, shipped free across the UK.

A 2025 release in a striking royal blue Hawas flacon. Mysteries from the endless ocean — mineral freshness woven into deep woody refinement, marine and salty and quietly powerful. For the man who navigates life with confidence and style.
A new force in the Hawas legacy. Passion, power and sophistication in their purest form — aromatic, marine and ambery, the energy of a blazing flame balanced with an aura of refinement.

A bold and magnetic woody Eau de Parfum for the modern man who embodies strength, elegance and untamed energy. It opens on a vibrant fusion of Bergamot, Pineapple and Grapefruit — a fresh citrus burst that instantly wakes the senses. A refined heart of Cedar, Patchouli and Jasmine adds depth and character, blending aromatic and herbal facets with effortless sophistication, before the scent settles into Oakmoss, warm woody accords and Amber for a powerful, lasting trail.

A fragrance that becomes an obsession. Hawas Elixir is an expression of intense desire — a unisex vanilla-aromatic Eau de Parfum that blends cool freshness with sinfully sweet temptation. Icy mint, tangy bergamot and aromatic artemisia open the composition, giving way to lavender, bittersweet dark chocolate and balsamic benzoin, before settling into creamy vanilla, tonka bean and soft musk. Made for evenings and cold months.

Hawas For Her Éclat — a radiant fragrance of grace and allure for her. It opens with the juicy sweetness of lychee and pear wrapped in sparkling bergamot and pistachio. A delicate rose blooms at the heart, enriched by the smoky mystique of incense, before vanilla and amber lend warmth and sensuality — musk and soft woods finishing with effortless elegance. An oriental floral introduced in 2025.

Created in 2015 by Claire Liégent and Dominique Ropion, housed in a golden python-inspired flacon. A floral woody haute couture fragrance laced with exotic gourmand warmth — fruity sparkle, couture florals, an addictive praline trail.

A 2025 feminine release in a translucent pink gradient bottle. Egyptian Neroli lifted by Cinnamon and Nutmeg opens sparkling and spicy-citrus, before Orange Flower, Tuberose and Golden Marshmallow build a lush floral-gourmand heart. It settles into Cotton Candy, Vanilla and Tonka Bean for a creamy, addictive trail — at its best in autumn and winter, and on cooler spring and summer evenings.

A 2025 release in the Shuhrah collection for him, in a silver-foiled 90ml flacon. Darkly magnetic and addictively indulgent — a tropically vivid opening of guava, mango and neroli falling into smoky woods, warm spice and melted-chocolate richness, then a resinous woody drydown. A midnight signature for the night's leading man.

Shuhrah Opulence Pour Femme, the original flagship of the Shuhrah collection for her — freshly uplifting and effortlessly charismatic. Zesty bergamot opens bright and refined, giving way to a complex heart of smoky frankincense, aromatic cedar wood and earthy oak moss with soft floral inflections, before settling on a precious oudh base that lingers with quiet Arabian depth. Fresh-citrus, smoky-resinous and beautifully lasting.

The force and clarity of the open sea — the energy of a wave just before it breaks. Crisp sea salt and spicy ginger open onto an oceanic heart of seaweed and vetiver, grounded by cedarwood and oakmoss. Cool, restrained and quietly commanding.

listings.rawTitle: Hawas Ice Travel Gift Set EDP 100ml
listings.description: Hawas Ice made travel-ready: the full-size 100ml Eau de Parfum plus a pocketable 8ml mini. Frozen apple and Italian citrus over iced plum, finished with driftwood and amber — one bottle for home, one for the carry-on, gym bag or desk drawer.

listings.rawTitle: Hawas For Him Travel Gift Set 100ml
listings.description: The original Hawas For Him in a two-piece travel set: the full-size 100ml Eau de Parfum plus an 8ml mini that slips into a pocket, bag or carry-on. Fresh bergamot, apple and cinnamon over amber, musk and patchouli — the signature that started the collection, at home and away.

Hawas Fire as a complete routine — the 100ml Eau de Parfum with matching bath and body pieces in a gift-ready box. Herbaceous French clary sage opens onto Egyptian jasmine and marine notes, settling on salty ambergris and mineral amber, from morning shower to evening.

listings.rawTitle: Hawas Ice + Hawas For Him EDP 100ml
listings.description: The two most-worn Hawas signatures in one box — the crisp bergamot and driftwood of Hawas Ice beside the aquatic, ambered original, Hawas For Him.

Fresh meets foundational. Hawas Atlantis 100ml opens with bergamot and galbanum over mineral, salty marine notes and creamy sandalwood; Hawas For Him 100ml grounds the pair with the citrus-aquatic, spicy-woody signature that built the Hawas legacy. Daytime freshness and evening confidence in one box.

Elemental opposites come together in one versatile Hawas duo for men. Hawas Fire 100ml is bold and intense with a warm, sophisticated character — ideal for evening wear, special occasions and moments when you want to make a confident impression. Hawas Ice 100ml is cool and refreshing, designed for daytime wear, warm weather and men who prefer a crisp, energetic signature. Two distinctive profiles for different moods, seasons and occasions — and an excellent men's fragrance gift set.

Shuhrah For Him — the original flagship of the Shuhrah collection and a freshly uplifting, effortlessly charismatic signature. Zesty bergamot opens bright and refined before a complex heart of smoky frankincense, aromatic cedar wood and earthy oak moss with subtle floral inflections, settling on a base of precious oudh that lingers with timeless Arabian depth. Fresh-citrus, smoky-resinous and beautifully lasting — an everyday classic for the modern man.

Shuhrah Sensuelle For Her — the feminine counterpart to Shuhrah Pour Homme, and a floral ode to elegance and charm. It opens on fresh lemon lifted by a touch of sensual sage, then unfolds into an elegant heart of lily of the valley, jasmine and iris. The composition settles on distinctive musk, exotic patchouli, exclusive ambergris and agar wood — aromatic, softly oriental and refined enough for everyday wear.

La Yuqawam For Him — Arabic for “irresistible”, and the original flagship of the La Yuqawam trilogy. A leather-led modern classic that opens on sweet raspberry, golden saffron and herbaceous thyme, moves through a smoky-floral heart of olibanum, jasmine and artemisia, and dries down to smoky leather, soft suede, refined woods and warm amber. Fruity, spicy, smoky and deeply masculine — built for evening confidence.

Part of the La Yuqawam trilogy For Him — an oriental woody-tobacco signature that balances fresh floral brightness against deep smoky warmth. Sun-kissed neroli, dewy muguet and golden saffron open refined and subtly spicy, before powdery violet, sweet apricot accord, coumarin, amber and cedarwood build a gourmand-woody heart. The dry-down of earthy patchouli, smoky leather and pure Indian oud lingers rich, warm and unmistakably oriental.

Al Wisam Day For Him — a crisp, refined oriental fougère that captures the luminous calm of daylight breaking over still water. Zesty bergamot, green geranium and soothing lavender open fresh and uplifting, before a balanced heart of velvety rose, creamy sandalwood, herbal clary sage and warm cedar turns it distinctly masculine and polished. The base of skin-warm musk, earthy oakmoss, precious agarwood and resinous amber keeps it present through the day and into the night.

listings.rawTitle: Rumz Al Rasasi 9325 Zebra Pour Lui 50ml
listings.description: Rumz Al Rasasi 9325 Zebra Pour Lui — the 2014 release from the Rumz Al Rasasi three-edition series, housed in its iconic zebra bottle. A bright, individualistic signature For Him: zesty bergamot, spicy cardamom and crisp green apple open sweet and succulent, a cheerful heart of lily of the valley, freesia and jasmine adds a green floral lift, and a base of smoky leather, cedar wood, patchouli, white musk and ambergris brings the dark, sensuous depth. Brightness and shadow in perfect zebra balance.

Ward Noir — a unisex composition for her and for him that takes rose into deeper, more mysterious territory. A juicy tropical fruit accord, sweet blackcurrant and spicy pink pepper open vivid and intriguing, a velvety Turkish rose heart carries the darker tone that defines it, and a base of resinous labdanum, earthy patchouli and warm amber wraps everything in a rich, mystical trail. Presented in a generous 200ml bottle.
